cover.headline: Same token price. *$0.14* a task versus *$0.41*.
cover.sub: Meta's Muse Ember lists at Claude Haiku 5.5's price. Four launches on 9 Nov, the bill behind each, and two free courses.

items.title: Muse Ember: Haiku's price, *a third* of the bill
items.statLabel: per Artificial Analysis task, against $0.41 for Claude Haiku 5.5
items.what: Meta's new small model lists at $0.10 in and $0.50 out per million tokens, the same as Haiku 5.5. Both score 36 on the AA index.
items.why: Same sticker, about a third of the cost per task, because the bill follows tokens spent. Compare models on dollars per finished task.

items.title: Claude Fable 5.2 is *20% cheaper*. Read the terms
items.statLabel: per million input tokens, down from $10. Output is $40, down from $50
items.what: Anthropic's top model has a 1M context and leads the AA index at 65. Mythos 5.2 is the same model, for vetted security and bio teams.
items.why: It still costs 2x Opus 5.5 per token and needs 30-day data retention unless Anthropic approves zero retention. Clear both first.

items.title: ChatGPT Enterprise now bills through *AWS*
items.statLabel: products in one listing: Chat, ChatGPT Work, Codex and dots
items.what: Sold by OpenAI, billed by AWS, and eligible spend counts toward AWS commitments. Pricing comes as a private offer.
items.why: The invoice moves to AWS. OpenAI stays the data processor, with AWS as a subprocessor, so the vendor review still has to happen.

items.title: Google Maps in AI Studio: prototype with *no card*
items.statLabel: free calls per API per day in the AI Studio sandbox
items.what: Describe a map app to Gemini and AI Studio wires in Maps, Places and Routes with no credit card, then shows a live map.
items.why: A branch finder or delivery map can be demoed in one sitting. Production needs a billing account, so price it before you promise it.

courses.title: Jev: Prefill-Only Inference from Scratch
courses.note: freeCodeCamp, about 2 hours, posted 29 Oct. Models that decide in the prefill pass, with no token-by-token decoding.

courses.title: Hybrid Search in PostgreSQL: BM25 + Vectors
courses.note: freeCodeCamp, about 1 hour, posted 21 Oct. Keyword and vector search in one database, merged in SQL.

read: Ember matches Haiku's sticker and costs *a third* per task. Fable 5.2 got cheaper and still runs *2x* Opus 5.5 per token. The AWS listing moves the invoice, not the data.
takeaway: Price the finished task, not the token. Then read the retention terms.
